Remote access permission model and argument lock ordering against address space locks are not shown.
Descriptor prepare and complete actions and filesystem preparation effects are not shown.
Merge, expand, iterator, transparent huge adjustment, and maple tree mechanics are not shown.

findings.text: Memory admission accounts the requested pages first, then applies a global overcommit policy. Always mode succeeds, guess mode only checks against RAM plus swap, and strict mode derives a commit ceiling minus a privileged reservation and a per address space growth allowance before comparing against committed total. On failure it emits a throttled warning, reverses accounting, and signals shortage.

Strict admission never lets an unprivileged caller use the administrative reserve, and never lets one address space alone consume the whole commit allowance because a fraction of its size bounded by a user reserve is subtracted. Guess admission is independent of commit counters.

Command line fetch pins the target address space, refuses work when the argument end marker is empty, snapshots argument and environment bounds under protection, copies the argument span with forced remote access bounded by caller length, and normalizes for overwritten separators by measuring strings or appending environment bytes.

Object diagnosis tries slab diagnosis first, then vmalloc region diagnosis, and otherwise classifies the pointer into vmalloc address, valid direct address, null, zero sized sentinel, or non paged memory before continuing the log line.

Vmalloc region diagnosis aligns the address down, resolves the owning node, acquires its busy structure only if uncontended, looks up the area, and when an area with backing metadata exists it reports page count, base, and allocation site. Missing area or contended lock yields a negative result without logging.

Offline control uses one read write semaphore with paired operations: freeze and thaw take and release read ownership, begin and end take and release write ownership. Read side allows concurrent freezes while write side excludes them.
Argument bounds are read under a dedicated address space spin protection with a short critical section that copies four boundary values and releases before any potentially blocking remote copy.

Vmalloc busy tree lookup uses per node spin protection. Diagnostic lookup uses a try acquire and abandons on contention, while global successor search acquires and releases each node in turn and then revalidates the lowest candidate under its owning node lock with a retry if it vanished.

The fragments declare a global address space lock mutex, a global free area spin lock, per pool spin protection, and per busy and lazy tree spin protection. Cache pointers for virtual areas and per CPU deferred free state are also present.

Mapping state aggregates owning address space and iterator, target range and file offsets, length, dual flag view, file and page protection, driver hooks and private data, charged amount, neighbour areas, unmap helper state with detach machine, and early KSM plus file pinning hints.

Prepare state references the area being changed, an adjacent area, file, address space, anonymous structure, and areas to insert or remove, plus a probe skip hint. Batch unlink state holds a small fixed array of areas with a count.

Unmap state records iterator, first and neighbouring areas, fault handling list, aligned range, page table range, removal count, unlock and table clearing hints, and accounting for pages, locked pages, charged pages, and execution, stack, and data usage.

Merge state records address space and iterator, previous middle and next areas with a merge target, proposed range and offsets, dual flag view, file, anonymous structure, policy, fault context, name, outcome code, copy source, caller behaviour hints for expansion and out of memory and probe skipping, and internal adjust and remove markers.
Unmap descriptor records maple state, first area, page table floor and ceiling, address span, tree search bound and restart point, and whether write protection is held.

Vmap bookkeeping uses a tree plus list plus lock triple for busy and lazy sets, a size segregated pool list with length, and a node holding many pools, pool lock, populate skip hint, busy and lazy sets, purge list and work, and purged count. Default configuration is a single node.

Deferred free state pairs a lockless list with a work item and is instantiated per CPU. Fit classification enumerates no fit, full fit, left edge, right edge, and interior placement. Merge outcome enumerates start, no memory, no merge, and success.

Compatibility mapping converts an established area into a zeroed descriptor with address space, file views, range, offset, flags, protection, and operations defaulting to no action; runs filesystem preparation; clears a hide until complete marker because invocation comes from mapping path; then prepares, writes back mutable and driver fields, and completes the action in compatibility mode.

Downward relocation validates ordering, requires no intervening area, expands coverage over old plus new span, moves page tables for the stack, frees the vacated directory range with distinct overlap and non overlap paths bounded by the next area or ceiling, gathers and finishes translation updates, then shrinks to the new span only.

Initial stack creation allocates an area, takes write protection killably, runs shared page setup, marks anonymous stack with soft dirty when supported, places one page at the maximum top, inserts it, publishes one page of stack and total usage, and on any failure unwinds sharing state, releases protection, frees the area, and clears outputs.

Sparse area mapping validates sleep context, rejects reset permission or no guard areas and non sparse areas, rejects spans larger than total RAM and spans outside the area, then maps with kernel protection or unmaps with cache and translation flushing. Unmap validation failure silently returns.

Successor area search strips tagging, walks each busy tree for the first area ending beyond the address preferring containment, tracks the lowest start across nodes, then relooks under the owning node lock. If the candidate disappeared the whole scan repeats; otherwise the owning node stays locked on return.

Kernel virtual to page translation walks directory levels in order, returns absent on empty entries, warns on malformed entries, resolves huge leaves by adding the address offset within the leaf, and only resolves the final entry when present.
Kernel range unmapping always flushes cache first, removes mappings without flushing, then flushes kernel translation entries over the same span.

Shrinking an area requires the new end not beyond the old end, configures the iterator over the truncated tail, preallocates before mutating, starts area write mode, prepares, adjusts transparent huge state, clears the tail, updates the range, completes, and validates the address space.

Several paths return allocation shortage without side effects beyond accounting reversal: iterator preallocation in shrink, expansion or table move in relocation, and area allocation in stack creation. Killable lock acquisition can abort stack creation with interruption.

Diagnostic and validation helpers fail safely: busy lock contention yields false, absent backing yields false, malformed or out of range sparse requests yield error or silent return, and page walk failures yield null. Relocation table move failure leaves cleanup to process teardown.

Largest pooled virtual allocation size is 256 pages. Debug augment checks are disabled with zero values. Header guards and trace point creation markers are defined. Validation helper is a no operation in this configuration.

Two build configurations exist for input remap huge page ceiling and for permitting huge vmalloc: one mutable early boot value with a disabling boot option, and one fixed conservative value. Free tree root starts empty and lazy page accounting starts at zero.

Public helpers exposed here include memory admission, remote command line fetch, object diagnosis, offline freeze and begin pairing, compatibility descriptor mapping, area shrink, stack relocation and creation, kernel range unmap, sparse page map and unmap, kernel virtual to page and frame translation, and successor area lookup.
